completed_stage_receipts.summary: Confirmed cross-owner product-boundary defect: internal executor/readiness modes were surfacing as if they were user-facing routes.
Mapped user -> ChatGPT owner/Skill -> owner GitHub authority/state -> internal capability dispatch -> canonical workflow; all four BUSINESS owners in scope, business task truth out of scope.
Prior fixes created guarded chat execution and readiness routing but omitted a shared product-interface boundary; escalated to system architecture.
First-party product architecture supports one Skill workflow over optional tools; no separate user workflow or mandatory MCP per executor is required.
Reused existing architecture/readiness/validator surfaces; no new root policy, Agent, registry, service, or MCP layer.
Rejected chat-only explanation, Financial-only fix, and deletion of execution labels; accepted shared single-entry/internal-dispatch invariant.
Resolved current BUSINESS topology and owner heads; normal executor selection is a system decision rather than user choice.
Selected shared architecture/readiness/blueprint plus owner Skill/manifests; no account/custom-instruction change.
Designed compact product_interface contract and deterministic regression with owner router wording only where needed.
Retained internal assurance labels while deleting their user-route semantics; no parallel workflow or service added.

Implemented shared internal-dispatch product boundary and propagated architecture manifest 1.3. Initial M7 validation exposed a compatibility mistake; corrected contract schema back to 1.1 and moved the new mandatory field to manifest 1.3 while preserving legacy 1.2. No stage reopen was required because controller had not left M7.

Universal risk-tiered audit, Agent architecture harness and full pytest pass. All four owner manifests reread at exact v1.3 heads. Private owner Actions did not allocate runners (empty steps, runner_id 0), so owner CI PASS is not claimed.

All current BUSINESS owners now declare one ChatGPT entry, system-internal execution-mode selection and one canonical owner workflow. Financial/A-share hot-path Skills were corrected where route leakage existed; Novel/Video avoided gratuitous Skill rewrites and preserve their existing assurance semantics.
